svg.title: Alberta log coverage of sampling envelopes
svg.desc: Bars showing the share of the 176 Alberta sampling envelopes covered by any log, by a known Litho_unit and by a known Rock_type, with the counts of fully covered envelopes.
svg.text: Alberta: logged geology over the 176 Cu/Zn sampling envelopes
1960.1 of 1960.4 m covered; 173 of 176 envelopes fully covered
285.6 of 1960.4 m covered; 51 of 176 envelopes fully covered
207.4 of 1960.4 m covered; 36 of 176 envelopes fully covered
A piece logged with two different known codes would be a conflict, not a choice; this report has none.
2 envelopes cross the 0.05 m where MR-14 is logged twice. Codes -9999 and blank are unknown.
